basis: Written before running the evaluator, from the USDA Closure Call brief, docs/ACCEPTANCE.md graded-posture proposal, and NWS product meanings. Expected posture assumes the alert covers the facility and is active.

notes.Coastal Flood Warning: A flood warning for the facility's location. The brief's intent is the same posture as other flood warnings; listed so a policy gap shows up as a miss, not a silent pass.
notes.planning: Watch: no posture is proposed; status must be planning review, never an all-clear.
notes.none: Advisory or statement: must not propose any posture.

powerOut: Any alert labeled telework or delay, with facility power reported out, expects closure.
